style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.gl_call_rook_coldwake: A gauntleted iron hand pressing a pale stone grave marker into frozen battlefield mud at dusk, dry flower seeds spilling from the gauntlet onto the frost, a torn banner and broken spears in the fog behind
pictures.gl_call_rook_coldwake_2: A low stone grave marker casting a long shadow across frozen ruts, a black rail ticket with silver lettering lying square on top of the stone, cold blue dusk, battlefield mist
pictures.gl_call_tobin_hayward: Hands of stitched burlap and dry straw knotting a wicker charm around a blighted wheat stalk in dead dark soil, a scarecrow field under a low orange moon
pictures.gl_call_tobin_hayward_2: A single green shoot breaking the cracked dirt beside rotten wheat, a black rail ticket with silver lettering resting in the woven wicker charm, warm lantern glow
pictures.gl_call_silas_vane: A scarred alley table at night, a deck of carved bone slivers fanned across it, chalk tally marks scratched on the wood, a gambler's hands and a lamp swinging overhead, a long shadow on the wall that lags behind
pictures.gl_call_silas_vane_2: A gambler's gloved hand turning over the last card of a game: where a bone card should be lies a black pasteboard ticket stamped in silver letters, the other cards scattered, lamp glow
pictures.gl_call_delphine_ravelle: An empty carnival midway past midnight, striped tents and dead bulbs, a woman's hand pulling tight a thread in a patchwork cuff, on the canvas wall behind her the shadow of a floating jester mouthing a silent rhyme
pictures.gl_call_delphine_ravelle_2: The torn lining of a notebook with silver letters gleaming on a black rail ticket tucked inside, carnival bulbs glowing out of focus, bunting and moths
pictures.gl_call_lucan_houndstooth: Heavy paw prints in cold black mire, a ghostly pale mastiff showing its ribs standing in fog among dead reeds, a hunter's boots and a coil of rope in the foreground, back view only
pictures.gl_call_lucan_houndstooth_2: A pale ghostly dog lifting its paw from the mud, leaving a black rail ticket with silver lettering pressed into the earth beside the print, green fog
pictures.gl_call_cordelia_skein: Crimson silk letters spinning in the air above glowing ruby vials on an alchemist's bench, each letter dissolving before it cools, a spider-silk cocoon in the corner, a woman's gloved hands only
pictures.gl_call_cordelia_skein_2: Threads woven around a black rail ticket stamped with silver letters in the corner of a dim laboratory, ruby light from vials, strands of silk catching the glow
pictures.gl_call_custom: A traveler's hand resting on a cold iron door latch, a lamp burning low in the window, an empty nail on the wall where a house key should hang, quiet cottage porch at night
pictures.gl_call_custom_2: An empty key hook on a wall, and in the place of the iron key a black rail ticket catching lamplight in sharp silver letters, a lantern's warm glow
pictures.gl_arrives: A burying hill under heavy fog at night, leaning headstones and a ring of standing stones on the crown, carved turnip lanterns glowing on gateposts, paper lanterns hung in an old yew, a warm lamp-glow growing behind the mist, a fiddle tune in the air
pictures.gl_arrives_2: A black steam locomotive rolling in on rails made of mist onto a hilltop shelf, blue-white lamp like an eye, smoke billowing and full of faint faces, ghost-teal fog, standing stones silhouetted
pictures.gl_ticket: A tall mottled-green frogman conductor in a ragged wide hat with three railroad spikes stepping down from a black train car with a fiddle under his arm, seen from behind in lantern light, fog and turnip lanterns
pictures.gl_ticket_2: A gloved silhouette hand holding up a silver-lettered black ticket to be punched, brass lamp glow, an amphibian hand with a ticket punch reaching in from the side
pictures.gl_into_shroud: A black ghost train pulling away from a burying hill at night, its brass lamps glowing, swallowed by slime-green smoke, standing stones shrinking behind
pictures.gl_into_shroud_2: Inside a 1920s train car looking at a window: slime-green smoke streaming past the glass and the empty glowing eyes of pale ghost passengers reflected in it, red leather seats, brass lamps
pictures.gl_phantom_strikes: A shadow with a tilted head unfolding from a red leather train seat in a lit 1920s passenger car, branch-like black tendrils, pale ghost passengers frozen in their seats, brass lamps
pictures.gl_phantom_strikes_2: Branch-like black tendrils shattering the windows of a train car, slime-green mist spilling in across the aisle, glass flying, brass lamps flickering
pictures.gl_phantom_strikes_3: A passenger's face splitting open into a monstrous block-toothed one-eyed maw with eyes in its open palms, in a lit train aisle, grotesque and terrifying, green light
pictures.gl_songstress_last_song: A hollow smoking ghost singer in a 1920s lounge car in lamplight, her cigarette burning down for the first time, ghost-teal glow, art deco ebony and gold, seen in profile with no clear face
pictures.gl_songstress_last_song_2: A lord and lady in 1920s evening clothes dancing cheek to cheek in a lounge car as a ghost singer fades into smoke at the window, burgundy velvet, warm gold light
pictures.gl_curse_reaches_fuel: Black root-veined tendrils whipping out of iron pipes and cracking a round porthole in a cast-iron tank full of glowing soul coal, riveted fuel car, orange and green glow
pictures.gl_curse_reaches_fuel_2: Glowing soul coals darkening to black and shooting up iron pipes in a train's tender, ghostly embers, black veins spreading through the metal
pictures.gl_curse_reaches_fuel_3: A furnace door bending and blowing off its hinges in a gout of ghostly green flame, a fire elemental made of corrupted soul coal bursting out, soot and sparks
pictures.gl_crash_and_moon: A wide shot of black train carriages scattered through ancient oak woods like dropped cards, deep grooves gouged in the earth, soul-mist teal in the grooves, night
pictures.gl_crash_and_moon_2: Looking up through a broken canopy of ancient oaks at a vast crescent moon with a leering crone's face, sickly green light, owls, dread and awe
pictures.gl_crash_and_moon_3: Thick black roots coiling round the wheels of a fallen locomotive lying on its side on a rise in a dark wood, steam leaking, the crone moon above
pictures.gl_locomotive_wakes: Black tendrils slithering into the smokestack of a pinned locomotive in a moonlit oak clearing, ghost-green light inside the firebox, glowing cans
pictures.gl_locomotive_wakes_2: The front of a black locomotive twisting into a monstrous face with burning eyes that turns toward the viewer, roots snapping, smoke boiling, menacing
pictures.gl_locomotive_wakes_3: The locomotive's face warping into an iron grin, branch-shaped black souls billowing from its smokestack in the moonlight, gargantuan and horrifying
pictures.gl_last_stop: A broken locomotive lifting off the ground as its dents straighten, mist pouring from the wheels, moonlit oak clearing at the first light of dawn, warm gold tint at the horizon
pictures.gl_last_stop_2: Black carriages flying back through the oaks to couple behind the engine, lamps glowing gold and teal, dawn light
pictures.gl_last_stop_3: The whole ghost train rising into the dawn sky, a frogman in a wide hat waving from the cab window, mist rails trailing behind it, warm gold and violet sky
